ev.q: Pooled data collected in 2014 and 2015 were used to compare demographic characteristics and HIV testing among transgender and cisgender respondents.
The proportion of respondents who reported ever and past year HIV testing was calculated
The unadjusted prevalence of ever testing for HIV was 37.5% among transgender women
Transgender women and men reported a substantially lower prevalence of ever and past year testing than did cisgender gay and bisexual men
Adjusted for: race/ethnicity, age, education, annual household income, health insurance
BRFSS is an annual, state-based, random-digit–dialed cellular and landline telephone survey

methods_quotes.q: Multivariable logistic regression models compared self-reported prevalence of ever and past year testing
while adjusting for characteristics associated with testing in univariate models (p<0.10)
All estimates were weighted to account for the complex multistage sampling design
Estimates with relative standard error ≥30% were not reported.
